verifications.claim: As of 2026, WWE WrestleMania is available on Netflix internationally.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first WrestleMania to livestream on Netflix in most international markets'; R3: 'exclusive home of WrestleMania 42 outside of the U.S.'; R5: 'Netflix... own the rights to all WWE content – including WrestleMania – globally'; R6: 'members in the following countries and regions will be able to tune in live on Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Netflix streams WrestleMania live internationally starting 2025/2026.

verifications.claim: Netflix houses the full WWE archive.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Netflix’s US$5 billion, ten-year deal which also sees it house WWE’s archive'; R6: 'every WrestleMania in WWE history is streaming on Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: R5 explicitly states Netflix houses WWE archive globally; R6 confirms full WrestleMania history available.

verifications.claim: Netflix acts as the live home for international WWE fans.

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Netflix as primary live streaming platform for WWE events and Raw internationally.

verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation for WrestleMania 42 live on Netflix outside US.
